# Draft:2026 Billie Jean King Cup

----
The 2026 Billie Jean King Cup will be the 63rd edition of the Billie Jean King Cup, a tournament between national teams in women's tennis.
Billie Jean King Cup finals
Date: 21–26 September 2026
Venue: Shenzhen Bay Sports Center, Shenzhen, China
Surface: Hard indoor
Eight nations will take part in the Finals. The qualification is as follows:
* 7 qualifying round winners
* 1 host nation (China)

Date: 10–11 April 2026
Format: 14 nations in 7 home-or-away ties across two days
These fourteen teams are:

* 7 winning teams from the 2025 play-offs
The seven winning teams from the qualifying round will play at the Finals and losing teams will play at the 2026 play-offs.

Billie Jean King Cup play-offs
Date: 19-21 November 2026
Format: 14 nations in 7 home-or-away ties across two days
These fourteen teams are:
* Seven losing teams from the qualifying round, in April 2026
* Seven winning teams from their Group I zone
Seven winners will advance to the 2027 qualifying round while losers will contest in their respective regional Group I event in 2027.
